Dheeraj Sangore

Business Analyst – Payments & FinTech | SAFe® 6 Certified Product Owner Pune, India | + 9209049571| dsangore10@gmail.com

LinkedIn: www.linkedin.com/in/dheeraj-s-7aa9b4285 | Target Markets: UK, EU, USA (Seeking VISA Sponsorship)

Profile

Certified SAFe® 6 Product Owner and Business Analyst with 7 years of experience across Retail Banking, Financial Services, Card Payments, Cards Issuing, Cards Acquiring, and FinTech. Experienced in Visa/Mastercard card-scheme and regulatory programmes, regulatory control frameworks, compliance matrices, RTM, and risk/control traceability. Strong knowledge of AML, PSD2, PCI DSS, GDPR, ISO 20022, and regional banking regulations, with experience supporting country-level regulatory implementations, compliance validation, and control testing. Skilled in commercial/corporate cards, end-to-end payment lifecycles, requirements gathering, BRD/FRD, process mapping, UAT, and Agile delivery. Proven track record delivering banking and payments transformation initiatives for global clients, collaborating across business, technology, and operations teams.

CORE COMPETENCIES & TOOLS

Domain: Retail Banking, Financial Services, Card Issuing, Card-Present (CP) Payments, Merchant Onboarding, API







• •

Integrations, RPA, Fraud Systems (FRAMS), ACS, Digital Banking, Payment Lifecycle Management. Compliance: ISO 20022, PCI DSS, GDPR, AML, PSD2, Privacy by Design (PbD), Mastercard AN 6138, Regulatory Compliance. Business Analysis: BRD, FRD, Functional Workflows, Use Cases, Process Maps, Flow Diagrams, Requirement Traceability Matrix (RTM), Business Case Development. Product: SAFe® 6, Product Roadmaps, Epics, User Stories, Acceptance Criteria, Backlog Refinement, User Story Mapping & Wireframing (Figma/Jira), Stakeholder Management. Technical: SQL (PostgreSQL), API Payload Mapping, Postman, Swagger, GitHub Copilot (AI Agents). Tools: Jira, Confluence, Visio, Miro, Tableau, Figma. Testing & Delivery: UAT Support, Defect Triage, Test Planning Inputs, Risk & Dependency Tracking.

Experience BUSINESS ANALYST - Risk & Reporting | BITWISE | CLIENT: GLOBAL PAYMENTS – FINTECH |JULY 2025 – PRESENT











AI-Driven Modernization: Leading multiple Agile PODs to modernize legacy PowerBuilder platforms. Utilized AI agents within GitHub Copilot to reverse-engineer legacy codebases, reducing discovery time by 40%. Product Delivery: Driving requirement gathering, BRD/FRD documentation, and functional workflow definition, along with UI/UX story creation using Figma prototypes and wireframes. Backlog Ownership: Authoring epics, user stories, and acceptance criteria; maintaining prioritized backlogs and roadmap inputs in Jira for cross-functional delivery teams. Stakeholder Collaboration: Working closely with business, IT, and operations teams to translate business needs into scalable solutions. Strategic Pre-Sales: Authoring Points of View (POVs) and delivering high-impact product demos for global RFPs, aligning modernization goals with business ROI.

BUSINESS ANALYST | WORLDLINE GLOBAL SERVICES - FINTECH | AUGUST 2024 – JUNE 2025





Card Issuing & Compliance: Spearheaded integration of Card Issuing authentication and issuer data to meet Mastercard AN 6138 standards, enabling secure processing for €22M+ in transactions. Functional Documentation: Created detailed BRDs, FRDs, functional specifications, and process/flow diagrams for Card Issuing platform enhancements, supporting regulatory and compliance requirements.





Architectural Traceability: Built E2E Interface and Component Catalogues from scratch, functioning as a requirement traceability matrix (RTM) and increasing Card Issuing system traceability and cross-team development speed by 60%. Risk Mitigation: Identified and secured GDPR/PCI DSS-sensitive fields across Card Issuing workflows and data flows, reducing compliance risk by 60%.

Digital Initiatives: Contributed to Card Issuing and digital banking transformation initiatives by enhancing

authentication and fraud systems, supporting UAT cycles ahead of releases.

BUSINESS ANALYST L3 | WIPRO | NOV 21 – JUL 24

Clients: Cynergy Bank, UK (FinTech) | Standard Bank, SA (FinTech) | MGM RESORTS, US (Shift 4 Integration – Fintech)

Global Gateway Launch: Delivered a multi-processor Payment Gateway for MGM Resorts supporting Auth, Sale,



Refund, and Tokenization. Requirement Analysis: Led requirement gathering sessions and translated business requirements into functional specifications, use cases, and workflows.

Messaging Standards: Designed a data transformation engine supporting industry-specific data elements in line

•



with ISO 20022 standards. Test & Release Support: Contributed to test planning and UAT coordination ahead of production releases. Stakeholder Management: Collaborated with cross-functional stakeholders across geographies (UK, US) to ensure seamless implementation. Agile Delivery: Worked in Agile/hybrid delivery models, ensuring alignment between business and technical teams.

PRODUCT OWNER/SENIOR BA | QUANTUM PHINANCE | OCT 19 TO NOV 21 Client: Axis Bank, IN - FinTech

Projects: RPA Implementation (Automated ~25 Retail Banking Processes)



•

RPA Implementation: Automated 25+ Retail Banking processes for Axis Bank. Managed requirement gathering, process mapping, BRD/FRD creation, business case development, and UAT. Process Improvement: Identified opportunities to optimize business processes and improve operational efficiency. Stakeholder Engagement: Coordinated with business and operations teams to ensure successful implementation and adoption.

PROJECT MANAGEMENT TRAINEE | GENERAL MOTORS, PUNE| JUNE 18 TO MAY 19 Project: The problem statement is that the A/C 9000 contributes 11.8% in the total CPU of the car, which accounts for 423 headcounts. The objective is to identify opportunities, i.e., the non-value-added activities in the process, with a goal to reduce the headcounts by 5.8%, thereby reducing manpower cost for Leeway agency. MTM system is used as a standard tool to calculate the MPU.

Education & Certifications

Master of Project Management | COEP Technological University | 2019

Bachelor of Engineering | SP Pune University | 2017

Certifications: Certified SAFe® 6 Product Owner/Product Manager, UiPath RPA Business Analyst, Tableau Analyst, Design Thinking (Beginner), SQL for PostgreSQL.

Thought Leadership / Publication

Published research paper on topic “Reduction in Manufacturing Cost by Optimizing the Manual Part Handling System” ISBN: 978-93-88441-69-8.

How a fake QR Code hijacked real payment rails and what it means for digital banking and payment security

sections.label: Summary
sections.text:
Profile
Certified SAFe® 6 Product Owner and Business Analyst with 7 years of experience across Retail Banking, Financial Services, Card Payments, Cards Issuing, Cards Acquiring, and FinTech. Experienced in Visa/Mastercard card-scheme and regulatory programmes, regulatory control frameworks, compliance matrices, RTM, and risk/control traceability. Strong knowledge of AML, PSD2, PCI DSS, GDPR, ISO 20022, and regional banking regulations, with experience supporting country-level regulatory implementations, compliance validation, and control testing. Skilled in commercial/corporate cards, end-to-end payment lifecycles, requirements gathering, BRD/FRD, process mapping, UAT, and Agile delivery. Proven track record delivering banking and payments transformation initiatives for global clients, collaborating across business, technology, and operations teams.
CORE COMPETENCIES & TOOLS
Domain: Retail Banking, Financial Services, Card Issuing, Card-Present (CP) Payments, Merchant Onboarding, API



• •
Integrations, RPA, Fraud Systems (FRAMS), ACS, Digital Banking, Payment Lifecycle Management. Compliance: ISO 20022, PCI DSS, GDPR, AML, PSD2, Privacy by Design (PbD), Mastercard AN 6138, Regulatory Compliance. Business Analysis: BRD, FRD, Functional Workflows, Use Cases, Process Maps, Flow Diagrams, Requirement Traceability Matrix (RTM), Business Case Development. Product: SAFe® 6, Product Roadmaps, Epics, User Stories, Acceptance Criteria, Backlog Refinement, User Story Mapping & Wireframing (Figma/Jira), Stakeholder Management. Technical: SQL (PostgreSQL), API Payload Mapping, Postman, Swagger, GitHub Copilot (AI Agents). Tools: Jira, Confluence, Visio, Miro, Tableau, Figma. Testing & Delivery: UAT Support, Defect Triage, Test Planning Inputs, Risk & Dependency Tracking.

AI-Driven Modernization: Leading multiple Agile PODs to modernize legacy PowerBuilder platforms. Utilized AI agents within GitHub Copilot to reverse-engineer legacy codebases, reducing discovery time by 40%. Product Delivery: Driving requirement gathering, BRD/FRD documentation, and functional workflow definition, along with UI/UX story creation using Figma prototypes and wireframes. Backlog Ownership: Authoring epics, user stories, and acceptance criteria; maintaining prioritized backlogs and roadmap inputs in Jira for cross-functional delivery teams. Stakeholder Collaboration: Working closely with business, IT, and operations teams to translate business needs into scalable solutions.
